FROM refunds;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM tickets
WHERE resolved_at IS NOT NULL
  AND satisfaction IS NULL;

SELECT MAX(DATE(delivered_at)) AS most_recent_delivery_date
FROM orders;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
WHERE placed_at >= '2026-04-01'
  AND placed_at < '2026-07-01';

SELECT name, country
FROM customers
WHERE trim(name) = 'Walsh' COLLATE NOCASE
   OR trim(name) LIKE '% Walsh';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customer_count
FROM tickets;

SELECT MAX(quantity * unit_price_minor) / 100.0 AS max_line_dollars
FROM order_items;

SELECT id AS refund_id, amount_minor / 100.0 AS amount_dollars
FROM refunds
ORDER BY amount_minor DESC, id ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (COUNT(*) - COUNT(order_id)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS percentage
FROM tickets;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM (
    SELECT order_id
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) >= 3
);

SELECT
    strftime('%Y-%m', opened_at) AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS opened,
    COUNT(*) - COUNT(resolved_at) AS still_open
FROM tickets
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM customers AS c
WHERE c.country = 'Germany'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM orders AS o
    WHERE o.customer_id = c.id
      AND o.status = 'delivered'
  );

SELECT c.segment,
       ROUND(AVG(t.satisfaction), 2) AS average_satisfaction
FROM tickets AS t
JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = t.customer_id
WHERE t.satisfaction IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.segment;

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.amount_minor), 0) / 100.0 AS refunded_dollars
FROM refunds AS r
JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = r.order_id
WHERE o.placed_at >= '2026-01-01'
  AND o.placed_at < '2026-02-01';

SELECT o.id AS order_id,
       COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor), 0) / 100.0 AS merchandise_value_dollars
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id
LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE c.name = 'Mona Park'
GROUP BY o.id
ORDER BY o.id;

SELECT c.name AS customer_name, COUNT(t.id) AS ticket_count
FROM customers AS c
LEFT JOIN tickets AS t ON t.customer_id = c.id
WHERE c.segment COLLATE NOCASE = 'reseller'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name;

SELECT
    o.status,
    COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor), 0) / 100.0 AS amount_dollars
FROM orders AS o
LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY o.status
ORDER BY o.status;

SELECT c.name
FROM customers AS c

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM tickets AS t
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM refunds AS r
    WHERE r.order_id = t.order_id
);

SELECT c.name, c.country
FROM customers AS c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM tickets AS t
    WHERE t.customer_id = c.id
);

SELECT
    c.name AS customer_name,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor) / 100.0 AS revenue_dollars
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY revenue_dollars DESC, c.id ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * AVG(EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM refunds AS r
    WHERE r.order_id = o.id
      AND r.amount_minor > 0
)), 2) AS refunded_percentage
FROM orders AS o
WHERE o.delivered_at IS NOT NULL;

WITH customer_spend AS (
    SELECT c.id, c.country, c.name,
           SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor) AS spent_minor
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY c.id, c.country, c.name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY country
               ORDER BY spent_minor DESC, id
           ) AS rn
    FROM customer_spend
)
SELECT country AS country_code,
       name AS customer_name,
       spent_minor / 100.0 AS amount_dollars
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY country_code;

SELECT p.name AS product_name, COUNT(oi.order_id) AS order_count
FROM products AS p
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
HAVING COUNT(oi.order_id) >= 25;

SELECT
    c.country AS country_code,
    ROUND(AVG(JULIANDAY(o.delivered_at) - JULIANDAY(o.placed_at)), 2) AS avg_delivery_days
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'delivered'
  AND o.delivered_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY c.country;

WITH in_transit AS (
    SELECT o.id AS order_id,
           c.name AS customer_name,
           CAST(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(date(o.placed_at)) AS INTEGER) AS days_waiting
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.status = 'in_transit'
)
SELECT order_id, customer_name, days_waiting
FROM in_transit
WHERE days_waiting > 120
ORDER BY days_waiting DESC, order_id ASC;

SELECT p.name, p.category
FROM products AS p
WHERE p.price_minor > (
    SELECT AVG(q.price_minor)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
